items.title: How a KDF's cost parameter reshapes an attacker's total campaign time
items.description: An illustrative model, back-derived from this unit's own measured scrypt timings (3.7ms at N=2^10, roughly doubling in cost per cost step). One real login pays this cost once; an attacker pays it once for every password guess. Drag the KDF slowness level and the attacker's guess count to see how small login waits compound into days or years when paid billions of times.
items.compute: const loginTimeMs = 3.7 * Math.pow(2, params.costLog - 10); const attackerDays = (loginTimeMs * params.numGuessesBillions * 1e9) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24); return { loginTimeMs: Math.round(loginTimeMs * 10) / 10, attackerDays: Math.round(attackerDays * 10) / 10 };
